page_title: LAZ 2-1 VER | Lazio v Verona 16/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' A spell of possession for Verona in an attempt to control the game.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
90' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Mattia Zaccagni will be replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
89' That will be all from Flavius Daniliuc who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Amin Sarr (Verona).
89' Substitution. Adam Marusic (Lazio) in, Manuel Lazzari out.
89' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Dani Silva and he is replaced by Alphadjo Cisse (Verona).
88' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
87' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo was alert and made a comfortable save.
86' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
85' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the right side of the goal is far too weak and Lorenzo Montipo makes a simple save.
84' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
84' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
81' Substitution. Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Rovella walks off.
80' Verona get a corner.

80' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
76' Verona fail to score from a corner as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.

76' Faride Alidou (Verona) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Verona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

74' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Lorenzo Montipo! Lazio will take a corner kick.
70' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
67' Faride Alidou comes onto the pitch after Abdou Harroui (Verona) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
67' Here comes a substitution. Davide Faraoni (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Darko Lazovic.
66' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) replaces Gustav Isaksen.
66' Gaetano Castrovilli comes onto the pitch because Taty Castellanos (Lazio) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
63' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Lorenzo Montipo. What a save!
62' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
60' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
58' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) commits a rough foul. Luca Zufferli stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Lazio, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
57' A bullet header by Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post.
57' Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
54' The Verona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
53' Reda Belahyane (Verona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lazio.
53' A substitution has been made. Grigoris Kastanos is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
52' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

52' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
51' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
50' Unlucky! A great strike from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
47' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.

47' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Zufferli with no other option than to blow for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Mario Gila (Lazio) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
43' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Abdou Harroui (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
39' Abdou Harroui (Verona) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
38' Lazio keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
35' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. Luca Zufferli had a clear view and blows his whistle. Verona have a free kick.
35' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. Good work from Lazio as they win a corner.
33' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
30' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
28' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
24' The linesman signals that Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
24' Neat passing move from Verona in order to create new attacking opportunities.

20' 2 - 1 Mattia Zaccagni produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Taty Castellanos (Lazio) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish. 2:1.
20' Now Lazio have a corner.

20' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
19' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).
19' Ivan Provedel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Darko Lazovic (Verona). The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
18' Darko Lazovic (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Verona will have a corner.
17' The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.

17' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
16' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

16' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the top left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
15' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
9' Verona have a corner.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Casper Tengstedt (Verona). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Verona.
7' 1 - 1 Casper Tengstedt (Verona) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
7' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) tackles a bit over-zealously and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
5' 1 - 0 Boulaye Dia (Lazio) picks up a brilliant lofted pass just outside the box and smashes the ball into the bottom left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
4' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
3' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Mario Gila (Lazio) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
